text: Litteris et Artibus is a Swedish royal medal founded in 1853 by Charles XV of Sweden, who was serving as crown prince at the time. It is conferred upon individuals who have made significant contributions to culture, with a particular emphasis on music, dramatic art, and literature. The obverse of the medal features the portrait of the current King, while the reverse side displays the Latin inscription "Litteris et Artibus," meaning "Letters and Arts."
